note_for_manuscript: Training-loop wall time is synchronized at entry/end; includes every-step loss/residual logging, sampling, forward/backward, optimizer/scheduler, monitoring, all periodic saves and interim report snapshots. Excludes initialization and final report packaging. Per-step CPU reads synchronize CUDA and add overhead compared with the original 100-step logging. Program-main time excludes module imports. No extrapolation from a shorter run.

platform_notes.host_memory_metric: Windows peak working set (peak_wset), not Linux ru_maxrss; not numerically interchangeable
platform_notes.gpu_process_memory_reason: Windows WDDM: nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps does not report per-process memory; authoritative torch.cuda peaks (allocated/reserved) are captured instead
platform_notes.per_step_overhead: Detailed-logging mode: per-step GPU diagnostics + per-step file logging add sync overhead vs original 100-step logging; do not substitute original timing without noting this
